newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka focus in Finnish '98 net borrowing - fin min.
newsitem.headline: Markka focus in Finnish '98 net borrowing - fin min.

text.p: Most of the Finnish central government's net financing need for next year -- a total of 14.5 billion markka -- will be borrowed in markka, finance ministry budget chief Erkki Virtanen told reporters on Friday.
"It will certainly be mainly in markka," Virtanen said when asked how much of next year's net borrowing the government intended to raise at home in markka and how much abroad in foreign currencies.
So far this year, Finland has been a net repayer of foreign currency denominated loans, according to state treasury figures for January-July.
The government on Friday completed work on its 1998 state budget proposal, which will be given to parliament on September 2.
